isolatedCharacter.acceptance: Pikachu must read as part of an ensemble and arena system; no lone transparent mascot over an empty field.
isolatedCharacter.evidence: Pikachu, Mew, and Mewtwo are contained in one official raster with shared perspective; the broadcast ribbon contains four human competitors; two cards form the collectible foreground.

lightingConflict.acceptance: All newly composed foreground objects need a shared lower-stage anchor; the Championships photo must read as a screen/ribbon, not the same camera space.
lightingConflict.evidence: The character ensemble stays within its original light system. Both cards share one lower stage baseline and added drop-shadow direction. The Championships image is bounded by an angled blue frame, ARENA FEED label, and color veil, so it reads as a screen rather than a competing scene.
lightingConflict.note: The two card illustrations have their own printed artwork lighting; this is acceptable because they are readable as physical card surfaces, not live characters in the arena.

brandWeakening.acceptance: At least three non-text Pokémon TCG signals remain visible after removing the logo: ensemble art, authentic cards, and official Championships environment.
brandWeakening.evidence: Blind signals are the three-character official art, two authentic full cards, Championships venue graphics, and the red/blue battle-floor rings. The logo is reinforcement, not the only identifier.

informationHierarchy.evidence: Navigation and HUD are subordinate; headline owns the first read, ensemble owns the second, cards/broadcast create lower-stage narrative, and CTA closes the path.

assetPolicy.evidence: All raster and font assets resolve to persisted repository files declared in asset-manifest.json. No generated arena image and no source screenshot are used.
assetPolicy.scopeRisk: This is a host-direction experiment, not a claim that the combination itself is an approved source-site pattern. Final adoption still needs parent apply-host review.

verdict: This is materially closer to the requested A-style arena atmosphere than the current empty-arena plus lone-Pikachu implementation. It should be tested as the official-assets control line before generating any new hero raster.
